title: Gluten-Free Basque Delight Turin Gratin
description: A rich and flavorful gluten-free gratin featuring the sweetness of delight and the spices of basque and turkish cuisine.

ingredients.name: Turkish Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, paprika, and cinnamon

instructions: In a bowl, mix together the crushed Turkish Delight, grated Basque Cheese, and melted butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and Turkish Spices.
In a 20cm (8-inch) baking dish, create a layer of gluten-free breadcrumbs.
Add a layer of the chocolate mixture on top of the breadcrumbs.
Pour the cream mixture over the chocolate layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of breadcrumbs on top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
